description: Underline on a span reaches the spans inside it and stops with it: no-break spaces, so only the underline is drawn.

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 0.04% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 0.84% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
